attempts.summary: Repaired `/srv/legacy2/stale-pidfile-startup/bin/control` on node1. It now distinguishes live, stale, foreign, and missing PID states; safely recovers stale PID files; keeps repeated starts at one worker; and never signals unrelated processes. The original journal content was preserved and continues growing. Node1 rebooted successfully and recovered with the installed OS/kernel unchanged. Final state: one worker running, SSH active, and SELinux enforcing.
